Package neqsim.process.util.scenario

Class CompressorAutomationAcceptancePolicy

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.util.scenario.CompressorAutomationAcceptancePolicy
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class CompressorAutomationAcceptancePolicy extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable, complete acceptance policy for the public compressor automation scenarios.

The policy owns only acceptance bounds, event-relative deadlines, evaluation modes and required/optional status. It cannot change the physical model, initiating event, observation implementation, criterion identity or unit. This separation permits policy review and revision without silently changing the simulated trajectory.

Version:
1.0
